results.description:
Predictable is a multi-award winning text-to-speech app for people with conditions such as ALS/MND, autism, cerebral palsy, Down's syndrome, and more. It aims to make it easier and quicker to communicate, using a range of access methods, rate enhancement features and customisation options.

Word Prediction
Using smart word prediction technology, the app makes speaking out a text-based message easy. Predictable learns from your pattern of use and predicts what you will type next, making typing easier and more efficient.


Phases and categories 
Save and organise phrases that you need quick access to in a simple grid format. Further customise your phrases by adding symbols, images, audio recordings, links and more. 


Shortcuts
Choose from a wide range of useful and exciting features such as notes, share, translate, chatGPT and draw to customise your keyboard screen to include features that you want to use. Attach these to keyboard keys, hot corners, head tracking gestures or external keyboard shortcuts. The possibilities are endless!


Multi Language
Switch between any of our 43 languages* to create your personalised bilingual set up. You are able to choose a primary and secondary language and seamlessly transition between both on the go, with appropriate keyboards and voices selected for both. Languages supported include: 
Arabic, Bangla, Bulgarian, Catalan, Chinese, Croatian, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Kannada, Korean, Maithili, Malay, Marathi, Norwegian (Bokmal), Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Punjabi, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Spanish, Swedish, Tamil, Telugu, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Gujarati, Urdu, Somali
*Some languages only offered with online voices 


Speech and Voice Options
Compatible with standard iOS voices, including the enhanced voices available to download and your iOS personal voice. You can also use your voice-banked voice from ModelTalker, Acapela, SpeakUnique and The Voice Keeper.


Accessibility
Predictable offers a wide range of access methods and accessibility settings including:
Direct touch features to handle accidental selection
Screen tap - a scanning method where you touch the screen for selection and/or progression
Switch access - accessible via Bluetooth switch box + switches (compatible with Therapy Box Switch Box and RJ Cooper Switch Interface) as well as Head tracking face gestures.
Head tracking - use facial recognition to interact with the app with no calibration or extra hardware required.
Auditory preview - hear the onscreen text before selection.
Scanning - Build your own, is a brand new access method in Predictable. Customise your own scanning method by combining timer, screen tap, switch access and gestures.

Appearance
Customise the layout and appearance to truly optimise the app to your preferences by changing the layout, font size, colours and more. Different keyboard options (including QWERTY, Ten Key, Apple and Bluetooth) and different templates (including Dark, High Contrast and Low vision) are available to make this customisation clear and simple.


Web Platform
Log in remotely and manage your settings and grid content from our web platform. The web platform is compatible with the myMessageBanking.com format to make importing easy.


Support
User guides are available on your app, and on the Therapy Box website. Send any questions to support@therapy-box.co.uk. You can find more about Predictable at https://therapy-box.co.uk/predictable

results.description:
Tap images. Type words. Speak. Proloquo2Go is an easy to use communication app for people who cannot speak or need help being understood. Featuring natural sounding voices, including real children’s voices, Proloquo2Go is a simple yet powerful AAC (augmentative and alternative communication) tool. The app is fully customisable and can be utilised to build language skills and grow with a person’s communication, supporting both beginning and advanced communicators.

Parents, therapists, teachers and users around the world recognise Proloquo2Go as the gold standard in AAC solutions. The app is used by people with autism, Down syndrome, cerebral palsy, Angelman syndrome, and others with speech difficulties. The app is available in English, Spanish, French, and Dutch and supports bilingual use, so you can switch languages on the fly.


Proloquo2Go in action:

Learn and grow
Studies show that just 200-400 words make up 80 % of what we say. Known as core words, they act as the basis of Proloquo2Go’s research-based Crescendo™ vocabulary. Users can grow from single words to full sentences in the same app. Crescendo puts core words in consistent locations for easy access and motor-planning. The vocabulary works with AAC best practices like modelling (where you use an AAC system to talk with the user) to develop language skills. Crescendo offers no limit on language development with a 10,000+ fringe word vocabulary and customisable vocabulary levels. Finally, with Progressive Language, words are gradually revealed step-by-step, helping users learn words and their location as their communication expands.

Easy editing
Customising Proloquo2Go is a breeze! Quickly and easily add new words. Use the app’s built-in library of 25,000 symbols or use your own photos by taking pictures within the app or selecting them from your photo library. For users with fine-motor challenges and vision impairments, Proloquo2Go offers options like 23 pre-programmed grid sizes and accessibility settings which support switch scanning and Apple’s VoiceOver screen reader. Everything from appearance to access is customisable so you can make it your own. 

Type and speak
Besides tapping images, Proloquo2Go also lets you type what you want to say. The app includes a Grid Keyboard arranged alphabetically for people learning to type. For more experienced typists, Proloquo2Go includes a Typing View with a QWERTY keyboard and word prediction that offers suggestions based on what you are typing. 

Hello! ¡Hola! Bonjour! Hallo!
Proloquo2Go lets you select a language and region for the Crescendo vocabulary. Two languages can be used at the same time, allowing seamless bilingual speech. Over 100 included downloadable natural-sounding adult and children’s voices rounds out your choices to use the app your way.

A helping hand
AssistiveWare is here for you every step of the way. Help articles in Proloquo2Go are there whenever you need them. New to AAC? Our website has easy to understand articles in the Learn AAC section, and the AssistiveWare Core Word Classroom includes activities for teaching communication effectively. You can also connect directly with our community of parents, professionals, and users on our Facebook groups. If you have any questions, our support team is available 7 days a week and is always happy to help. All of these online resources can be accessed by going to the AssistiveWare website. 

Note: Discounts are available through Apple’s Educational Volume Purchase programme – 50 % off on 20 licenses or more. Joan Bruno’s Gateway to Language & Learning© vocabulary is available as an in-app purchase (English only).

In order to use Proloquo2Go on Apple Watch, it must be paired with an iPhone.

results.description:
Speak turns your words into clear, natural speech. Many of Speak's users have lost their ability to speak, often after surgery, and Speak helps give them a voice again. It's also great for practising pronunciation, or just having fun with voices.

Features
• Lots of voices: Choose from every voice installed on your device, including Enhanced, Premium and Personal Voice. Search by language, name or region, and preview any voice with one tap.
• Fine-tune the sound: Adjust volume, pitch and rate, and repeat a phrase as many times as you need.
• Favourites: Save the phrases you use most and reorder them however you like.
• History: Every phrase you speak is saved, so you can speak it again or share it. You can also export your history as a CSV file.
• Share audio recordings: Turn any phrase into an audio file and share it anywhere.
• Make it yours: Light or Dark appearance, a high-contrast text field, and options for how Speak behaves when you type, speak and clear.
• Picks up where you left off: Optionally restore your text, voice, pitch, rate and repeat count when you open the app.
• Keeps talking in the background: Speech keeps playing while your device is locked or you're using another app.
• Louder with Bluetooth: Connect a Bluetooth speaker or headphones to make your voice heard even further.
• Works everywhere: No internet connection needed. Supports VoiceOver and iPad multitasking.

Quick Tip: If a word doesn't sound quite right, try spelling it phonetically.

Speak is free with ads. You can remove them with a single in-app purchase in Settings to support development.

Have fun! Feel free to email me with any suggestions or comments at loic@loic.tech. If you find Speak useful, please take a moment to leave a quick review!

results.description:
Speak4Me is a text to speech app that does two things: it reads aloud anything you want to listen to, and it speaks out loud anything you type. Listen to PDFs, documents, books, web articles and photos of printed pages – or type a message and let Speak4Me say it for you, in 120+ natural AI voices.

LISTEN: READ ALOUD ANYTHING

• PDF to audio – Import any PDF from Files or iCloud Drive and listen to it like an audiobook. Headers and footers are skipped automatically, so you only hear the content.
• Documents and books – Turn long documents, book chapters, study notes and reports into audio. Follow along with real-time text highlighting.
• Web articles – Listen to articles, blog posts and newsletters instead of reading them on screen.
• Scan and listen – Take a photo of a printed page, a book, a letter or a menu, and Speak4Me reads the text out loud.
• Listen anywhere – Keep listening while you commute, walk, work out or cook. Speed up the voice to get through your reading list faster.

SPEAK: TYPE TO SPEAK

• Type and Speak4Me talks for you – Write what you want to say and it is spoken out loud instantly, in the voice and language you choose.
• A voice when you need one – Made for people who have lost their voice, have a speech disability, are recovering from a stroke, or find it hard to speak in some moments. Use it to talk face to face, at the doctor, in a shop or on the phone.
• Favourite phrases – Save the sentences you use most and play them with one tap.
• AI voice-overs – Use Speak4Me as an AI voice generator and narrator: type a script and export it as an MP3 for videos, TikTok, Reels, podcasts, presentations and customer support.

NATURAL AI VOICES

• 120+ lifelike AI voices, male and female, in 20+ languages and accents.
• Ultra voices: our most human, expressive and fluid voices.
• Adjust voice speed and font size to fit the way you read.

MADE FOR EVERY READER

• Dyslexia-friendly font and text highlighting to make reading easier.
• Helpful for dyslexia, ADHD, low vision, language learners and anyone who prefers listening to reading.
• Save any audio and share it via iMessage, WhatsApp, email and more.

WHO USES SPEAK4ME

Students who listen to their notes and PDFs. Professionals who turn reports and emails into audio. Book lovers who listen to what they read. People who use their phone as a voice to communicate. Creators who need quick voice-overs.

FAQ

• Can Speak4Me read PDFs aloud? Yes. Import any PDF and listen to it like an audiobook, with headers and footers skipped.
• Can it read a printed book or document? Yes. Take a photo of the page and Speak4Me reads the text out loud.
• Can it read web articles? Yes. Listen to articles, blog posts and newsletters instead of reading them on screen.
• Can it speak for me? Yes. Type any sentence and it is spoken out loud instantly. Save the phrases you use most for one-tap access.
• Can I use it as an AAC app? Yes. Speak4Me works as a simple type-to-speak communication tool for people who can't speak or find it hard to.
• Can I create AI voice-overs? Yes. Type a script, pick one of 120+ AI voices and export it as an MP3.
• Does it help with dyslexia? Yes. It offers a dyslexia-friendly font and highlights the text as it reads.
• Can I change the reading speed? Yes. Slow it down or speed it up to fit the way you listen.
• Which languages does it support? 20+ languages and accents, including British, Irish, American and Australian English, French, German, Spanish and Italian.

Questions or feature requests? Write to us at support@bakeryscent.com

SUBSCRIPTION
Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel anytime in Account Settings. Any unused free trial ends when you subscribe.

Avaz AAC is an Augmentative and Alternative Communication App that empowers children & adults with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Down Syndrome, Aphasia, Apraxia, and individuals with any other condition/cause of speech delays, with a voice of their own.
“My daughter has nearly mastered navigation, so much so that one day she brought it to me to show me she wanted Taco Bell for lunch. This made me cry. My child had a voice for the first time. Thank you for being the one to give my daughter that "voice". - Amy Kinderman
Designed to aid language development, by presenting core words, which make up 80% of everyday speech, in a research-based order. This enables users to progress from using 1-2 word phrases to forming complete sentences.
Avaz, a fully AAC text-to-speech app with over 40,000 pictures(Symbolstix) and a range of high-quality voices, enables users to form sentences and express themselves with ease quickly. Avaz is a customisable AAC app that empowers users to express themselves authentically and build meaningful connections!

Effortless Backup and Themes
Enjoy the convenience of auto backup for worry-free vocabulary progress. Simply choose how often you want your vocabulary progress backed up with our auto-backup interval selection option. Never lose your progress again!
We understand our users have different preferences for cloud storage, so we made it easy to back up your vocabulary to your preferred platform, including popular ones like Google Drive.
Explore our visual themes - Classic Light, Classic Dark (with high contrast), and Outer Space (a dark mode). Our default dark mode has been beneficial for adult users and those using Avaz with eye-tracking devices.

Try Avaz AAC's free 14-day trial without adding credit card details! Make in-app purchases and choose from our affordable monthly, yearly, and lifetime subscription plans to keep benefiting from the amazing features.

Now available in English US, English UK, Français, Dansk, Svenska, Magyar, Føroyskt is fully compatible with iPads and iPhones.

If you’re new to AAC, don’t worry! Visit www.avazapp.com for beginner-friendly articles to help you get started. Connect with our passionate Avaz community on Facebook and other social media platforms.

We are always happy to hear from you. For any assistance, please write to us at support@avazapp.com

Note: Avaz AAC - Lifetime Edition is available for a one-time purchase and offers a 50% discount with VPP for 20+ licenses.

Weave Chat AAC is a free, dynamic, and completely customizable AAC app that is available to a variety of devices. 

There are over 3,500 pre-configured words with a symbol library including more than 65,000 symbols that you can choose from.

Weave Chat AAC offers a large variety of verbs (green), pronouns (yellow), questions (purple), nouns (tan/orange), adjectives (blue), and conversational words (pink). All color choices were made based on the Fitzgerald Key and new vocabulary is added weekly. 

Users can add their own custom images and categories in Settings —> Manage Custom Images.

In addition, users can add their own custom phrases that can easily be accessed from their board; to add phrases, go to Settings —> Manage Phrases. 

Users can select a synthetic voice (dependent on their device settings) from Settings —> Change Voice Settings - here you can select your voice, vocal pitch, and rate of speech.

Image and text size can be personalized from Settings —> Change Image & Text Size (select from default - small, medium, and large). Settings —> Configure Image Keyboard allows the user to turn on/off features that allow for the category text to be read aloud (synthetic voice for categories), to keep the user in the category after a image has been selected (stay on category after image selection), and disable the speech output for individual words so that it only reads aloud when the white text screen is touched (synthetic voice disabled for individual words). 

The AAC board can be modified in Settings —> Manage Board Builder. Here, the user can select from the default board (you must make a copy to edit it - to do this select “Add new keyboard” and then select “Hide Images” for Type of Keyboard); grid position boards (ranging in size from 1x2 - 7x15 rows/columns); and Board Builder (gives you the option to build a board from scratch). All boards are completely editable and all custom images and categories can be used from all boards.

Lastly, Manage Pin Configuration allows the user to set a pin over all (or just some) aspects of customization to lock down features as needed.

Feature List:
- Dynamic, customizable, AAC boards
- Large variety of verbs, nouns, and adjectives with additional vocabulary added weekly
- Add custom images and custom categories
- Create and save phrases
- Select a synthetic voice (as available per your device settings)
- Copy & Paste AAC picture icon messages via “share”
- Create and/or modify AAC boards via 3 options: grid position boards (ranging from 1x2 - 7x15), hide images, and/or create a new board from scratch
- “Text” others who have the app using AAC picture icons
- Set a passcode to lock down features as needed
- Weave Chat AAC currently only has English buttons/images

VoiceAgain Lets Your Phone Speak For You!

Text to Speech is a modern TTS (text to speech) app, designed to helps people who’ve lost their voice communicate again in person and call.

Text to Speech has a familiar “chat-style” interface, so it feels just like you're texting somebody, helping you speak with SPEED and EFFICIENCY.

HOW IT WORKS
————————
That’s easy – just type, then press “speak”.  

More specifically, AI Text to Speech produces natural sounding speech from the words that you type. 

WHO THIS APP IS FOR
———————————
For people who rely on text to speech every day:
Designed to be stable, predictable, and easy to use when you need it most.
Clear playback, saved phrases, and consistent behavior you can depend on.

USES
———
- I lost my voice, and I use to struggle to communicate with others. But then I found this app which enables me to speak to people again!
- I was bored, but not anymore! This app is surprisingly addicting and makes a fun and entertaining way to have my phone say funny things.
- I can even use this text to speech app as a text reader. Just copy and paste online articles, books, etc., and this TTS reader will read it to me.

Features we DO have
——————————
- Free to download. No ads either.
- Natural text to speech with a clean, chat-style interface.
- 56 voices across 38 languages.
- Adjust volume, pitch, rate, and tone.
- Save frequent phrases for quick access.
- Background Audio implemented so the text reader can continue playing even when your phone is locked.
- Email Support. Don’t hesitate to email any questions or suggestions you have while using this app. We hope to make your experience as great as possible.

Advanced features
—————————
- Voice clone for a more personal voice.
- Lifelike avatar voices with expressive tone control.
- Save spoken audio for replay or sharing.
- Smart Reply suggestions to speed up typing.
- Call for Me: let the app make phone calls for you.

Features we (happily) DON’T have
————————————————
- NO Ads
    - Sorry, we know you love being blasted by popup ads every second like many text to speech apps, but this app doesn’t have any.
- EASY to Try
    - A free text to speech app for basic communication and text reading.
    - Subscription unlocks unlimited communication and advanced features.
